captions.text: Average slope compares two points: change in height divided by horizontal change.
The tangent slope describes the limiting local direction.
A high point can have zero slope,
so height and steepness are different measurements.
Identify where the tangent is horizontal and where its sign changes.
What does a negative slope mean?
What does a negative slope mean?
